c: Wine Glass throws a wine glass at the nearest enemies which creates a small explosion on contact. At Level 1 to 3, it plays a light glass breaking sound effect; Level 4 to 6 is medium; and Level 7 and 8 is heavy.

is multiplied by 4, so each wine glass seems to create multiple explosions. At max level, each wine glass stacks 16 projectiles together. This can result in them piercing enemies despite only having one Pierce.
